html:
Knot Normal, a 2007 56’ Viking, was sold by Licensed FYI Yachts Consultant Raul Faget, who represented the seller.

This 56’ Sport Fishing Viking, measuring 57’6 in length with an 18’2 beam, offers luxurious accommodation with three staterooms, sleeping six guests and featuring two heads. This Viking 56’ sport fishing vessel features a spacious cockpit tailored for serious fishing, with ample storage and advanced fish-finding technology to guarantee an exciting and successful outing. Inside, includes a fully equipped galley and a roomy salon, perfect for relaxing after a day on the water.

KNOT NORMAL is located in Miami, Florida and the asking price was $899,000 at the time of the sale.
